lines.trans: Jean, are you there?
You are very marked by your role.
I have never experienced this before, never!
They are waiting for you for the shoot.
You have to play a modern banker.
Honestly, right now, I cannot!
I cannot follow on like that.

words.gloss: to follow on, to jump straight in

lines.trans: I spent six months in the forest.
I went down to bare human bone.
I refuse the noise and people!
But have you not signed your contract?
Yes, I signed my contract!
You signed Emile Berthier!
That is your character, Jean.
It is not you!

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

examples.text: Il y a beaucoup de bruit.

meanings.note: faire du bruit = to make noise
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel
dans une heure = in an hour

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

examples.trans: I have to see the play.

enchaîner.gloss: to follow on, to chain together

meanings.en: to follow on immediately, to chain together

examples.text: Je ne peux pas enchaîner deux tournages.
examples.trans: I cannot do two film shoots back-to-back.

examples.text: Il y a aussi de grandes forêts!
examples.trans: There are big forests there too!

examples.text: Il y a beaucoup de gens.
examples.trans: There are a lot of people.

meanings.note: always plural: des gens, les gens
for a group of men, or a mixed group; elles for women only

examples.text: Je ne suis jamais en retard.
Il joue le frère de Guillaume.

meanings.note: jouer un rôle, jouer le frère de...
jouer au foot, jouer du piano
before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Je veux, mais je ne peux pas.
examples.trans: I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: marqué en rouge = marked in red

examples.text: Les jours sont marqués en rouge.
examples.trans: The days are marked in red.

meanings.note: ne ... pas: not; ne ... plus: not anymore; ne ... jamais: never

examples.trans: As a child, I had fragile bones.

examples.text: Par exemple, le contrat de Canet.

meanings.en: pas du tout: not at all
un peu = a little, a bit

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

examples.trans: I can't take it any more.

meanings.note: je peux t'appeler? = may I call you?
je n'en peux plus = I can't take any more
être refusé(e) = to be turned down

meanings.en: part, role (in a film or play)

examples.text: Si tu veux le rôle, tu dois changer.
examples.trans: If you want the part, you have to change.

meanings.note: rien n'est signé = nothing is signed

examples.text: Il est mort il y a six jours.

meanings.note: pronounced si before a consonant: six jours = si ʒuʁ
before the verb; t' before a vowel
tout le temps = all the time
used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi
informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes

examples.text: Le tournage commence dans trois semaines.

meanings.note: from tourner un film = to shoot a film
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
vivre à Paris = to live in Paris
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
